name: serviceflow
description: Automated customer intake and scheduling system for local service businesses

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:server && npm run install:client
scripts.prisma:setup: cd server && npx prisma db push && npm run seed
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,emerald" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
